findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: Upon arrival, the only employee who is a certified food protection manager wasn’t present. The cfpm arrived shortly into the visit to correct the violation. The other two owners (married couple), are certified food handlers. Discussed the need of having at least 2 employees manager certified to cover all hours of operation. A website link was provided to the PIC to assist at least one employee with the certified manager’s course in Mandarin.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: There were a couple bins of raw chicken stored above raw beef inside of the walk in cooler. Shown to the PIC and the bins were rearranged to correct the violation. Ensure that raw chicken is always stored beneath any raw beef products to protect against cross contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(2) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (2) Except when combined as ingredients, separating types of raw animal FOODS from each other such as beef, FISH, lamb, pork, and POULTRY during storage, preparation, holding, and display by: (a) Using separate EQUIPMENT for each type, or (b) Arranging each type of FOOD in EQUIPMENT so that cross contamination of one type with another is prevented, and (c) Preparing each type of FOOD at different times or in separate areas.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: There wasn’t a sanitizer solution created despite the facility being in full operation. A sanitizer solution was created and tested at 100ppm to correct the violation. Ensure that a sani solution is always available if preparing, handling, or serving food.
findings.citation_text: 4-303.11(B) Cleaning Agents and Sanitizers, Availability. (B) Except for those that are generated on-site at the time of use, chemical SANITIZERS that are used to sanitize EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-7, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Accumulated food debris was observed on the floors underneath the cookline line. Shown to PIC. Ensure that floors are cleaned as frequent as necessary to prevent debris accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment, and linens: properly stored, dried, and handled.
findings.comment: Observed two cutting boards to be stored behind the faucet of the triple sink. Discussed with PIC and cutting boards were moved to a different location. Ensure that clean equipment is stored in a manner that protects against contamination.
findings.citation_text: 4-903.11(A) Equipment, Utensils, Linens, and Single-Service and Single-Use Articles. (A) Except as specified in (D) of this section, cleaned EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, laundered LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be stored: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
Observed at least two employees turn faucet handles off with barehands after the handwashing process. Discussed with PIC proper handwashing techniques. Ensure to use a barrier when turning off faucet handles to prevent recontaminating freshly washed hands. 

2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED.
